title: Netherlands: Growth Without Relief: Dutch Households Squeezed · 21 Oct
keywords: Netherlands economy, Dutch inflation, cost of living, Dutch election, fiscal policy, migration, European Commission, Rabobank, purchasing power, energy prices, minority government, EU fiscal rules, defense spending, trade unions
notes: The Netherlands is expanding economically, yet households face renewed pressure from rising fuel, energy and housing costs, with consumer prices climbing to 3.4 percent in September 2026. An approaching election is turning that frustration into a referendum on fiscal priorities, migration and the future of Dutch public services. The gap between official reassurance and lived experience may prove the campaign's most powerful political force.
